Seasons and the look of the world

The season changes how the world looks. In survival it also nudges the air temperature. Nothing you build, mine or walk on changes with it.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides
Contents

  2. Choose a season in creative
  3. Air temperature in survival
  4. What the season does not change

The four seasons

A full year lasts 80 real minutes, so each season lasts about 20 minutes. New worlds start in summer. The order is spring, summer, autumn and winter, then back to spring. Seasons

Each season changes the colours of grass, deciduous leaves, needles, blossoms and water. The sky and sunlight change too: autumn leaves turn russet, and winter light is cooler.

Choose a season in creative

  1. Press Esc and open the World tab in Settings.
  2. Click a Season chip, or use its arrows, to hold Spring, Summer, Autumn or Winter.
  3. Choose Auto to go back to the normal cycle.

The Season row reads AUTO / and the current season while the cycle runs. If a creative player fixed the season, the row shows that season instead. In survival you cannot change the row. Time, weather and season controls (creative)

Air temperature in survival

In survival the season moves the air temperature between about +7 C in summer and -7 C in winter, changing smoothly through spring and autumn. Time of day adds up to 9 C at midday and takes up to 4.5 C off at night. Rain lowers it by up to 2 C. Day and night Automatic weather

Your body temperature follows the air. It costs health only while it is outside -12 to 48 C. At sea level the air stays between about 2.5 and 32 C, so the season alone does not hurt you. Higher ground is colder. A roof and walls pull your temperature toward 20 C. Body temperature and shelter

Tip. The Home tab shows the current air temperature on its Temperature line, so you can check it before a long trip.

What the season does not change

  • No snow falls and no snow blocks appear.
  • Trees keep all their blocks. Leaves do not thin out.
  • Weather follows its own pattern, not the season.
  • The season does not change which animals appear or what crafting needs.

Planned, not in the game yet

Planned, not in the game. Planned: leaves that thin out on some trees, grass that looks snowy in winter, and seasons that no longer change survival temperature. Until these ship, the game works as described above.

How this guide was checked

Season length, the colours each season changes, the temperature values and the Settings > World rows come from the game source at the audited commit. The temperature formula was read from the code, not measured in play.
